claims.sourceText: FBI files on Roscoe H. Hillenkoetter, National Security Archive mirror; full-text search of the sections available
claims.text: The National Security Archive's mirror of the FBI files on Hillenkoetter -- eighteen serials plus a main file -- contains, across the sections text-searched, zero occurrences of NICAP, 'flying saucer', 'unidentified flying', Keyhoe, or the year 1960. OCR quality on these scans is uneven, so this is a strong indication rather than a proof.

title: FBI files on Roscoe H. Hillenkoetter, National Security Archive mirror
